messages:
alex: Heads-up — new partner CloudFab sent session-aggregated usage (one row per session). EU totals look inflated.
maria: can we get a sample payload and confirm if they can provide per-call rows? :thinking_face:
sam: sample (redacted): {"partner_id":"cloudfab-23", "session_id":"s-abc001", "start":"2026-03-22T10:00:00Z", "end":"2026-03-22T10:30:00Z", "tokens_used":9000, "sku":"cf-pro"} — they only send totals per session.
june: region missing too; misattributing region will break VAT/tax and partner credits.
ops_lead: confirmed most look like eu-central from network hints. need to be careful.
alex: short-term: ingestion hotfix to split session tokens into synthetic calls using sku_avg_tokens and tag synthetic=true so downstream systems can identify them.
maria: must be auditable and reversible if partner later supplies call-level detail. include logging and an ops SQL for quick audits.
billing-bot: ingest-warning partner=cloudfab-23 field=region_missing
sam: medium-term: update partner schema/contract to require call_count or request_list + region breakdown. long-term: per-partner compatibility flag for aggregated payloads.
june: add metric percent_tokens_synthetic per-partner and alert if >5%.
alex: timeline: hotfix by EOD tomorrow, PR from sam, dashboard change by june, partner call scheduled this week.
maria: action items: sam implement hotfix + tests (due 2026-03-25); june add metric/alert (due 2026-03-26); alex schedule partner call; ops_lead update reconciliation playbook for retro-conversions (due 2026-03-27).
maria: ops SQL to audit: SELECT partner_id, session_id, SUM(CASE WHEN synthetic='t' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS synthetic_tokens, SUM(tokens) AS total_tokens FROM billing_events WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-22' GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;
all: keeping thread open for PR/deploy updates.
